finding: The raw52-case manual manifest was explicitly superseded by a pre-existing published protocol correction. The new195-case baseline-compatibility harness compared the raw manifest without applying that existing correction.
correctionReason: The original independent oracle applied the final revertedBy flag to an earlier own read. The own overlay must instead be checked at the read event. A later rollback revokes a write effect, but does not invalidate a previously valid own read. Observations remain intact and valid own reads can be omitted from the intertransaction register projection. Reading a revoked version after rollback remains inconclusive. Both directions are covered below.

normalizerSourceEvidence.meaning: Own-read status is determined at observation time and preserved across later rollback; source checks apply to non-own reads; valid own observations remain in raw evidence but are omitted from intertransaction projection.
